title: Name the algebraic coordinates z in exudyn.misc.symbolicSystem, and in the nomenclature for Python code
author: Claude-JG
description: Lambda_ is not readable; z is the quantity of the nomenclature for algebraic coordinates; the formulas of the documentation keep lambda, the symbolic system and the user items use z, and the docstring of each argument says what it represents; the nomenclature says that z is used in Python code where lambda is not possible.
releaseNotes: exudyn.misc.symbolicSystem names the algebraic coordinates z - the Lagrange multipliers lambda of the documentation - in its arguments, Equations() and the results of SolveGeneralizedAlpha.
